title: Staff Product Manager, Carrier Integrations API
posting_text:
Cobalt Route connects shippers to 5,000 carriers through one API.

What you'll do
- Own the public carrier API, SDKs and certification program
- Set API versioning and deprecation policy
- Grow carrier self-serve onboarding

What we're looking for
- 8+ years of product management, 3+ on API or platform products
- Hands-on understanding of REST APIs and webhooks
- Experience running partner or developer programs

Nice to have
- Logistics or freight industry background
- Pricing and packaging for API products
company_text: Cobalt Route (fictional company for the sample data).
